# GeneratorReturnBeforeCompletion

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="native" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.0" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs)

A generator exposes its return value only after it finishes. Complete iteration before calling getReturn.

## Example

```php{2}
<?php
$g=(function(){yield 1;return 2;})(); $g->getReturn();
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Finish the generator before reading its return value.</li>
</ul>

## Detection

- A local assigned a call to a literal closure containing yield is immediately used as receiver of getReturn before any resume/iteration/next/send/throw operation. Report the method call; unknown calls or escape discard proof.
- Require an unconditional directly executed nondelegating yield in the generator body prefix before any terminating or ambiguous operation. Merely finding a yield somewhere is insufficient. Exclude dead or conditional yields, nested-scope yields, prior unconditional returns, and yield-from delegation, including delegation to an empty iterable.
- The first statement of the literal closure body must be an expression statement whose expression is a direct nondelegating yield. Preceding assignments, conditionals or other statements do not establish this initial suspended state; yield-from is excluded.
- The method name is matched case-insensitively, and the result does not have to be discarded. The call is reported when the statement directly after the assignment is an expression statement, a return or an echo that evaluates the call before anything else: the path from the call up to the statement may only pass through parentheses, unary operators and casts, the value of an assignment to a plain variable, the left operand of a binary operator, the condition of a ternary, the first argument of a call to a named function, and the first echo operand.
- Resolve builtin functions, classes, constants and methods; user-defined lookalikes are excluded. Follow only bounded local proof in one lexical scope.
- Emit one finding per violating operation, not per supporting evidence statement. When the proof is inconclusive, nothing is reported.

## Exceptions (no report)

- Do not report unresolved or shadowed builtin names, unknown values, or incomplete receiver/type provenance. Unknown calls, aliases escaping, and intervening writes invalidate local proof. Similar code outside the stated detection contract is not a finding.
- Do not report a read that another part of the same statement may precede or skip: a later array element, argument or echo operand, a right operand, a ternary branch, an argument of a method or dynamic call, an assignment to a non-plain target, a closure or arrow function body, or the head of a control structure.
- Both standard suppression forms suppress this native ID.

## Fix

None. Choosing a repair requires intent or additional runtime information.

## PHP versions

Requires PHP 7.0 or later.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "GeneratorReturnBeforeCompletion": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file):

```php
// @custos-ignore GeneratorReturnBeforeCompletion
```
